steps.name: Google Search To Maps
steps.goal: Search Google for restaurants in Marrakech and open the Maps experience/results page.
checks: Handle cookie/consent and overlays if they appear
Open Google Maps results for restaurants in Marrakech
steps.instructions: If blocked by modal/ad/overlay, run detect_blocking_overlay then dismiss_blocking_overlay.

steps.name: Open One Restaurant
steps.goal: From the Maps results/listing, open one specific restaurant detail panel/page.
checks: Ensure detail view is loaded before continuing

steps.name: Extract And Print Phone
steps.goal: Extract the restaurant phone number and finish only after printing it on console.
checks: If multiple numbers exist, choose the main restaurant contact number
When done, include the selected phone number in done.reason
steps.instructions: Do not finish without a valid phone number candidate.
